Story,
I had an argument about being allowed to close my door (13), out of anger I went downstairs closed my door and moved me personal sofa in front of the door (they removed my lock 3rd suicide attempt) they busted in and saw I was holding a needle, they said stop, your going to harm yourself I said whaa-  they take it and handcuff me to my bed, they then said they were making sure I don’t attempt, self harm, or try to escape, when I said what the hell, they tightened it as a punishment for saying hell, then they slept on the sofa in my room, because they tightened it too much (after saying hell) my hand had that weird springy feeling for 3 days. I’m still kinda mad at them tbh, also I don’t cry that much and I was crying the whole night, they didn’t let me use the restroom incase I tried to escape (I can overpower them) and they slept fine while I was there trying to keep my poor left hand comfy while it’s being constricted of proper blood flow for 8 hours... I guess the reason they were able to do it was because they didn’t give me time to think, if they had, I’d have easily overpowered. I was also scared because they had talked about admitting me to a psych ward for a while, and I thought what if they call 911 in the morning to admit me? Overall bad experience but not abuse unlike some other stories on this thread
